stories.title: Un ataque de los hutíes contra el aeropuerto de Riad causa al menos 12 muertos

en.title: Houthi attack on Riyadh airport causes at least 12 deaths
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked King Khalid Airport in Saudi Arabia's capital, resulting in at least 12 fatalities. Saudi authorities suspended all air operations at the airport.

stories.title: Trump rompe con Zelenski por el diésel: «Es hora de que Ucrania tenga un nuevo presidente»

en.title: Trump breaks with Zelenski over diesel: "It's time for Ukraine to have a new president"
en.summary: Trump called for Ukrainian President Zelenski's removal after reaching an agreement with Putin to inject Russian diesel into energy markets. Trump aims to lower fuel prices ahead of November elections.

stories.title: Trump carga contra Zelenski: "Ha llegado el momento de que Ucrania tenga un nuevo presidente"

en.title: Trump attacks Zelenski: "The time has come for Ukraine to have a new president"
en.summary: Trump criticized Ukraine's president following statements from Zelenski alleging American negotiators used him as a smokescreen for other purposes.

stories.title: Trump anima a los ucranios a que “busquen un nuevo líder” tras un ataque de Kiev contra el sector petrolero ruso

en.title: Trump encourages Ukrainians to "seek a new leader" following Kiev attack on Russian oil sector
en.summary: Trump urged Ukrainians to find new leadership, claiming Zelenski could have stopped the war multiple times but chose not to. At least 20 people died in Russian bombardment of Zaporizhia.

stories.title: Trump carga contra Zelenski y pide para Ucrania “un nuevo presidente” con el que pactar

en.title: Trump attacks Zelenski and calls for Ukraine to have "a new president" to negotiate with
en.summary: Trump criticized Ukrainian President Zelenski and expressed his preference to negotiate with a different Ukrainian leader. Zelenski responded sarcastically to a reported U.S.-Russia diesel agreement, characterizing Russian bombing strikes on Ukrainian territory as a show of appreciation.

stories.title: Miriam González presenta Democracia 21 para concurrir a las elecciones del 29-N: «Tengo una deuda monumental con mi país»

en.title: Miriam González presents Democracia 21 to run in November 29 elections: "I have a monumental debt to my country"
en.summary: Miriam González officially launched her political candidacy with the Democracia 21 movement for the November 29 elections. The event in Madrid, attended by approximately 700 people, featured symbolic messaging about political change through distributed gifts.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo y su pareja, detenidos por agredir a un intruso en su casa y morder a un policía

en.title: Rafael Amargo and his partner detained for assaulting an intruder in their home and biting a police officer
en.summary: Flamenco dancer Rafael Amargo and his partner Luciana Bongianino were arrested after an altercation at their Madrid home in which a National Police officer was bitten by Amargo. Neighbors had alerted police after hearing screams and sounds of blows.

stories.title: Miriam González se lanza a la arena electoral y presenta Democracia 21: "No podemos continuar con dos bloques sin nada que favorezca consensos"

en.title: Miriam González enters the electoral arena and presents Democracia 21: "We cannot continue with two blocs without anything that favors consensus"
en.summary: Miriam González launched her electoral candidacy with Democracia 21, running in Madrid and Barcelona constituencies. The lawyer challenged current political leaders regarding their ability to address Spain's problems.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo es detenido junto a su pareja tras una pelea con otra persona que entró en su vivienda de madrugada

en.title: Rafael Amargo detained with partner following altercation with person who entered his home early morning
en.summary: Dancer Rafael Amargo was arrested at a Madrid police station after an incident involving another person who entered his residence at night, facing charges related to assault on authority.

stories.title: González Durántez presenta su candidatura al 29-N con Democracia 21

en.title: González Durántez presents his candidacy for November 29 with Democracia 21
en.summary: González Durántez announced his electoral candidacy for November 29 through Democracia 21. He will seek endorsements to run only in the Madrid and Barcelona constituencies.

stories.title: Rafael Amargo y su pareja detenidos tras una pelea con otra persona que entró de madrugada en su vivienda de Madrid

en.title: Flamenco dancer Rafael Amargo and his partner arrested after a fight with someone who entered their Madrid home in the early morning
en.summary: Rafael Amargo and his partner were detained following an altercation at their Madrid residence. Amargo faces accusations of assaulting national police officers and causing injuries.

stories.title: Ucrania ataca una petrolera rusa tras el acuerdo del diésel entre Trump y Putin

en.title: Ukraine attacks a Russian oil refinery following the diesel agreement between Trump and Putin
en.summary: Ukraine conducted a nighttime attack on a Russian oil facility, downing over one hundred drones during the operation. The strike also reportedly damaged a railway bridge.

stories.title: Cómo funcionará la nueva cuenta de inversión del Gobierno

en.title: How the Government's new investment account will work
en.summary: A new investment vehicle for small savers allows contributions up to 150,000 euros and offers tax advantages to encourage investment in European stock markets.

stories.title: Guía para inquilinos y propietarios: cómo afecta la nueva regulación de la vivienda

en.title: Guide for tenants and landlords: how the new housing regulation affects you
en.summary: The first of two housing decrees approved by the Government took effect, redefining the rental and purchase market. Parliament's Standing Commission will ratify it on Friday.

stories.title: La amenaza latente para el mercado del alquiler: renovación automática con sanciones al casero

en.title: The latent threat to the rental market: automatic renewal with sanctions for landlords
en.summary: A second decree imposes minimum penalties of 12 months' rent on landlords who refuse to renew contracts after expiration.

stories.title: Cómo sacar partido a la fiscalidad de la vivienda tras el nuevo decreto

en.title: How to benefit from housing tax treatment after the new decree
en.summary: Tax specialists and real estate experts provide recommendations for owners, tenants, and companies following the new decree's implementation.

stories.title: La IA que ataca antes de que lleguen los ‘hackers’

en.title: AI that attacks before the 'hackers' arrive
en.summary: Horizon3 launches a platform in Spain using artificial intelligence to simulate cyberattacks and identify vulnerabilities in companies.
